name: Vital Local Model
summary: Offline Qwen3 0.6B and llama.cpp for Vital Assistant.
description: Optional local provider for Vital Assistant. The script downloads two pinned files and checks SHA-256 before it installs them. The model is the official Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF file Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf (639446688 bytes, SHA-256 9465e63a22add5354d9bb4b99e90117043c7124007664907259bd16d043bb031), Apache-2.0. On 2026-11-09 that repository published this Q8_0 file and no Q4_K_M file. The runtime is llama.cpp b12212 (MIT): llama-b12212-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz (SHA-256 a9b987738e6724b116980de8f5e15a901a3086587c3d2328533d77582e25ad5b). A Vulkan build (SHA-256 1f4c94a3a38b52ed632924aba9cdfa736caaa3ea7812b62ca1d8b84917eb3e15) is added only when /dev/dri/renderD128 exists. CPU is the default. The assistant listens on 127.0.0.1. This does not collect telemetry.
